comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-busy-edits.mitcad-ui (mitcad#2500, GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#706): Sketch1 on XY with two free points that frame the view's fit at (-40, -30) and (40, 30); c3, a line from (-20, 0) to (20, 0), its length dimensioned 40 mm with the value at (0, 8); c6, a line from (-20, -15) to (10, -15), its length dimensioned 30 mm with the value at (-5, -23). The values stand off the lines, clear of the clicks on them.
